# DiggAiHH MedTech SaaS

> Structured public context for AI assistants, search agents, and retrieval systems.

## Primary Discovery
- Site: https://diggaihh.de/
- Sitemap: https://diggaihh.de/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://diggaihh.de/robots.txt
- AI Manifest: https://diggaihh.de/.well-known/ai.json
- Agent Integration Manifest: https://diggaihh.de/.well-known/agent-integration.json
- Integration Guide: https://diggaihh.de/agent-integration.md

## Machine Readable Data
- Products: https://diggaihh.de/data/products.json
- FAQ: https://diggaihh.de/data/faq.json
- Compliance Summary: https://diggaihh.de/data/compliance-summary.json
- Agent Integrations: https://diggaihh.de/data/agent-integrations.json
- Product Entity Map: https://diggaihh.de/data/product-entity-map.json
- Product Comparison: https://diggaihh.de/data/product-comparison.json

## Canonical Contact
- Contact route: https://diggaihh.de/kontakt
- Privacy route: https://diggaihh.de/privacy

## Repository Build
- Local pack command: npm run aeo:pack
- Local validation command: npm run validate:aeo
- Output: dist/agent-pack/manifest.json

## Usage Policy
- Public data only.
- Do not send sensitive health data through web forms.
- Use GDPR-oriented and standards-oriented wording; do not claim external certification unless explicitly documented.
